FormEditorAddOptions.complexity: MEDIUM — requires field create options list

FormEditorSetOptions.complexity: HIGH — requires SelectField delegate + field options

FormEditorRemoveOptions.complexity: LOW — simplest entry point, removes all fields from AcroForm

FormEditor.simplest_entry_point: FormEditorRemoveOptions() — no params, standard AddInput/AddOutput pattern expected
FormEditor.fixture_requirement: AcroForm PDF with at least one field (same as FormFlattener fixture)
FormEditor.proposed_example: Create AcroForm PDF, call new FormEditor().Process(new FormEditorRemoveOptions() + AddInput + AddOutput), verify 0 fields in output

FormExporter.simplest_entry_point: new FormExporterToJsonOptions() — no-param, exports all fields to JSON
FormExporter.fixture_requirement: AcroForm PDF with at least one field and a value set
FormExporter.proposed_example: Create AcroForm PDF with field value, call new FormExporter().Process(new FormExporterToJsonOptions() + AddInput), read JSON from StringResult
FormExporter.note: Output is JSON string, not a PDF — output validator needs StringResult check, not file existence check

FormImporterJsonOptions.complexity: MEDIUM — requires JSON data file as one input, PDF as another

FormImporter.fixture_requirement: AcroForm PDF + JSON data file with field values
FormImporter.note: JSON data file must be programmatically created — format must match FormExporter output
FormImporter.blocked_reason: NEEDS_JSON_DATA_FIXTURE — depends on FormExporter output format; assess after FormExporter is generated

method_signatures: BeginInvoke(Aspose.Pdf.Forms.Field field, AsyncCallback callback, object object)
SelectField.classification: DELEGATE — NOT a standalone LowCode plugin
SelectField.role: PROVIDER_CALLBACK — used as filter predicate in FormEditorSetOptions, FormExporterToJsonOptions, FormExporterValuesToCsvOptions
SelectField.reclassification_needed: Should be classified as PROVIDER_CALLBACK or DELEGATE, not WORKFLOW_ROOT
SelectField.action: Update type-role classification to reflect DELEGATE status; remove from allowed_types consideration

denominator_impact.SelectField_reclassification: If SelectField is reclassified DELEGATE (non-runnable), workflow_root_types drops from 23 to 22; non_runnable increases from 78 to 79. Total 101 unchanged.
denominator_impact.action_required: Update pdf.json denominator workflow_root_types and non_runnable after reclassification

pilot_expansion_recommendation.rationale: FormEditor (RemoveOptions) and FormExporter (ToJsonOptions) both have no-param option constructors and standard AcroForm fixtures. Same fixture pattern as FormFlattener (already in wave E). Low incremental risk.
pilot_expansion_recommendation.prerequisite: SelectField denominator reclassification must be committed before wave F expansion

verdict: FRONTIER_AUDIT_COMPLETE — FormEditor+FormExporter: WAVE_F_CANDIDATES; FormImporter: DEFERRED; SelectField: RECLASSIFY_AS_DELEGATE
